hosted_agents_tag_help: Claude Tag channel sessions share a service identity; they do not run as the person who sent the Slack message.
hosted_agents_tag_disable_help: Disabling Claude Tag deletes its session workspaces in this environment.
hosted_agents_tag_grant: Grant this user access in this environment’s profiles and vMCP profiles. Its credentials use its own permissions.
hosted_agents_map_size_error: Paste at most 4 MB of member JSON.
hosted_agents_map_array_error: Paste a JSON array containing between 1 and 10,000 organization members.
hosted_agents_map_account_error: Every member must contain an account object.
hosted_agents_map_id_error: Every account must have a valid tagged_id or uuid.
hosted_agents_map_duplicate_error: The pasted list contains a duplicate Claude account.
hosted_agents_map_signin: Sign in to Claude in your browser as an administrator of this organization.
hosted_agents_map_instructions: Paste it below and click Preview mappings. Review the email matches, override any Obot users, then click Submit mappings.
hosted_agents_map_json_placeholder: Paste the organization members JSON array
hosted_agents_map_duplicate_selection: Each Obot user can map to only one Claude account per organization. Resolve the duplicate selections before submitting.
hosted_agents_map_copy_json: Open the following link and copy the complete JSON response.
hosted_agents_map_unavailable: Saved user {id} is no longer available. Select another user or Not mapped.
hosted_agents_profiles_help: Users matching any profile can use this environment. An empty profile list grants no access.
hosted_agents_profile_description: A profile defines what vMCPs, web destinations, and secrets a user, agent, or group has access to.
hosted_agents_profile_no_subjects: Add at least one user or group to this profile.
hosted_agents_profile_identities_descrip: Grant the following users, agents, and groups access to this profile.
hosted_agents_profile_actor_help: Blank fields inherit the environment. Matching profiles combine using the maximum per field; -1 means unlimited retention.
hosted_agents_profile_name_exists: A profile with this name already exists.
hosted_agents_profile_unsaved_apply: Would you like to apply them?
hosted_agents_profile_unsaved_save: Would you like to save them?
hosted_agents_sessions_user_error: Unable to load Obot user details. Showing user IDs.
hosted_agents_sessions_all_help: All users’ and Claude Tag sessions, with the status of their latest execution. Refreshes every five seconds.
hosted_agents_sessions_help: Each entry represents one Claude session. Chat in Claude; reconnecting resumes the same session with its saved workspace.
hosted_agents_sessions_empty: No sessions yet. Start a session in Claude using your connected environment.
hosted_agents_sessions_delete_note: All execution attempts and saved workspace files will be permanently removed.
hosted_agents_sessions_suspend_note: This interrupts the current execution and saves its workspace. New work from Claude can resume the session.
hosted_agents_sessions_no_matches: No sessions match your search or filters.
hosted_agents_env_help: An administrator maps your Claude account to Obot. Start sessions in Claude using an environment you have access to; its matching profiles determine your vMCPs and actor limits.
hosted_agents_env_keep_key: Leave blank to keep current key
hosted_agents_env_capacity_help: Worker requests match these limits. Substrate uses them as the capacity for scheduling actors.
hosted_agents_env_digest_help: Runner images must use a SHA-256 digest, configured under Advanced configuration.
hosted_agents_env_digest_title: Use repository@sha256: followed by the full 64-character lowercase hexadecimal digest. Tags are not supported.
hosted_agents_env_changes_help: Worker changes roll out to this environment's pool. Actor settings apply to new executions. Access changes apply to active sessions.
hosted_agents_env_ask_admin: Ask an administrator to map your Claude account for this organization.
hosted_agents_env_not_found: This environment could not be found.
hosted_agents_env_delete_question: Delete {name}? Its session workspaces and worker pool will be removed.
hosted_agents_actor_resources_help: CPU and memory use Kubernetes quantities, such as 500m and 2Gi. Retention must be positive, or -1 to disable cleanup.
hosted_agents_environment_stats_all: All retained sessions · Refreshes every five seconds
hosted_agents_environment_stats_own: Your retained sessions · Refreshes every five seconds
hosted_agents_managed_settings_object: Managed settings must be a JSON object.
hosted_agents_managed_settings_help: Optional Claude managed-settings.json. Applies to new executions, including resumed sessions. Leave blank to use the image default. Individual settings are your responsibility; Anthropic server-managed settings will take precedence.
hosted_agents_claude_tag_profile_require: Enabling Claude Tag does not grant access to this environment. The Claude Tag service user must match at least one of the environment’s profiles to have access.
hosted_agents_allow_all_egress_help: Allow HTTP on port 80 and HTTPS on port 443 to any hostname. Auditing remains enabled. Changes apply to running sessions.
hosted_agents_required_egress_help: Traffic to internal Obot services and HTTPS requests to api.anthropic.com on port 443 are always allowed, even when no additional egress hosts are configured and Allow all web destinations is off.
hosted_agents_profile_egress_help: Profiles only add access. Users receive the environment’s allowed hosts plus the hosts from every matching profile.
hosted_agents_profile_egress_hosts: Additional HTTPS hosts for this profile
hosted_agents_egress_wildcard_help: Use a hostname or a wildcard such as *.github.com. Wildcards match one subdomain level (api.github.com), not the root domain (github.com) or deeper subdomains (a.b.github.com). Add the root domain separately if needed.
hosted_agents_egress_secrets_help: Inject headers into HTTPS requests on port 443 to exact hostnames allowed by egress policy. Include the full header value, such as Bearer TOKEN. Values are never shown again. Profile secrets override environment secrets for the same hostname and header; the first matching profile wins.
hosted_agents_secret_keep: Leave blank to keep the saved value
hosted_agents_import_profile_empty: No profiles have vMCPs to import.
hosted_agents_configuration_help: Your matching environment profiles determine the access shown here. vMCPs also enforce their own access rules.
hosted_agents_all_egress_allowed: HTTP on port 80 and HTTPS on port 443 are allowed to any hostname.
hosted_agents_cli_help: Sign in to Claude CLI with your connected Claude account, then run this from a checkout of your repository. Replace the prompt with your task. The command creates a cloud session in this environment and prints a link to it.
hosted_agents_mapping_help: Unmapped Claude accounts are automatically matched when a session request supplies an email that uniquely matches an active, unmatched Obot user. Saved user assignments take priority. Members absent from the import are kept. Choosing “Not mapped” clears the assignment but allows future automatic matching. Changes apply to every environment in this organization; changing a mapping deletes the previous owner’s session workspaces. Environment profiles still control access.
hosted_agents_kubernetes_required: Claude Environments is only available in Kubernetes deployments. This Obot instance is running with Docker.
hosted_agents_egress_host_allowed: Traffic to external host: {host} is allowed.
hosted_agents_allow_claude_mcp_help: Allow access to Claude’s MCP relay. Blocked by default, even when all web destinations are allowed. Any matching profile can grant access.
